sloka: वसन्तो यदि तत्र अपि यत्र मे वसति प्रिया ।नूनम् परवशा सीता सा अपि शोच्यति अहम् यथा ॥४-१-४७॥
transliteration: vasanto yadi tatra api yatra me vasati priyā ।nūnam paravaśā sītā sā api śocyati aham yathā ॥4-1-47॥

translations.english: 'Spring must not have touched the place where she is now staying. Otherwise how could my Sita with eyes like blue lotus live without me?
